content.context: Taught state_resolver to treat Project Intelligence requirement and acceptance_criterion records as claims, so contradictions are detected instead of silently returned as OK. Added a subject_key_declared flag at import time so the derived content hash is never mistaken for a shared subject, which would have flagged every record in a project as conflicting. Surfaced the verdict in the dashboard with a new Trust capability tab that reads the peers from the same resolver.
content.decision: Group claims only when the source declared a subject_key, and expose the peers through conflict_groups() rather than letting the panel re-derive conflicts.
content.rationale: A conflict the resolver cannot report is worse than no report, because a reader told everything is fine will act on it. The panel had no way to name a contradiction, so the fix stayed invisible until the peers were projected alongside the state.

title: Conflict detection and the Trust tab
